problems.problem: The first title line 'Flora' (title bbox y 518-590) is set directly over the pale mint ribbon band, which crosses the text column at y ~460-620. Cream ink #f0ece0 on pale mint drops far below readable contrast exactly where the name begins, while lines 2-3 sit on clean viridian; the column reads unevenly and the headline's entry point is its weakest moment.

The declared material is a flat hard-edge printed ribbon on shadowless matte gouache, but the generated ribbon is a dimensional 3D band with fold shading and, critically, a cast drop shadow on the green field beneath the twist at roughly x 640-980, y 545-640 - directly under and behind the 'Flora' line. That shadow both breaks the shadowless flat-light concept and adds murky value noise behind the headline.

The right column is top-loaded: logo at y 425, three title lines to y 803 and the gold rule at y 871, then roughly 570 px of empty viridian below the rule while the bottle base sits at y 1311. The column never closes against the product's baseline, so the asymmetric grid feels unfinished rather than deliberate; the brief's 'monument' column should extend its rhythm toward the bottle's base zone.

The ribbon's modeled highlights and soft cast shadow conflict with the product photograph's soft diffuse frontal studio light and with the declared perfectly even graphic illumination; the band reads as a rendered object pasted into a flat card instead of a printed loop completing the circuit behind the silhouette.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte gouache-painted card in deep viridian green, one continuous hard-edge flat printed ribbon loop in uniform pale mint with no folds, no shading and no cast shadow, sweeping from lower left behind centre and re-emerging upper right but staying entirely below y 700 on the right half so the upper right quadrant remains plain uninterrupted green, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects

notes: Contact verified in the base crop [88,1171,625,1421]: a soft dark-green contact shadow hugs the full base line at y 1311 with no gap, so the bottle is not floating; shadow offset_y 0 is correct and left untouched. Product bbox [168,418,545,1311] gives height ratio 0.6201, inside both the hero range and the fresh-concept bounds (top 29%, base 91%, sides 15.6%-50.5%); silhouette, mint lacquer body, ribbed gold cap and printed floral label match the original with no extra bottles or invented labels. text_product_overlap is false for title and logo, so no overlap claim is made. No softboxes, lamps, stands or cameras appear; the flagged background issue is the ribbon's cast shadow and modeled folds versus the declared shadowless flat print, not studio equipment. References 3-5 show resolved integration (graphic orbit, lit environment, grounded group); this draft matches their ambition on product and concept but trails on headline legibility over the ribbon, column closure and light consistency, hence scores in the high-70s rather than pass territory.
